en: The Chapter on the Determination of Formless Phenomena, Part 14: Subtle Questions
“Venerable Nāgasena, is it possible to cut everything that is subtle?
“Yes, Great King, it is possible to cut everything that is subtle.”
“The Dhamma, great king, is indeed the most subtle; yet not all things, great king, are subtle. ‘Subtle’ or ‘gross’—these are designations for phenomena (dhammas).
Whatever is to be cut, all that is cut by wisdom; there is no second cutting besides wisdom.”
This is the fourteenth subtle question.
